bio: Avenue43 fuses modern elegance and hip vibes in a relaxed, easygoing setting. Have an aperitif at the bar before sliding into one of the plush round banquette seats. Both the à la carte and appealing set menu lean into the classics – with a modern twist. Rose fish, bream, mussels and cockles become a refined bouillabaisse. Steak tartare and crêpe suzette are finished tableside. Familiar flavours feature in indulgent dishes with a unique twist. Very cool!...
